title: Repository-root import preflight for script-hosted suite runner
failure_signature: The plan-only full-suite selector launched from the scripts directory and could not import the repository tests package.
trigger_preconditions: A Python runner stored under scripts imports repository test modules.
The runner is launched by file path rather than module mode.
candidate_workaround: Insert the resolved repository root into sys.path before importing test modules, then rerun only the plan-only selector.
recurrence_guard: Every script-hosted test selector must assert that its repository root is present in sys.path before discovery and must provide a nonexecuting plan-only mode.
rollback: Retain the import failure with zero suite credit, amend only the launcher path, and rerun plan-only discovery without executing tests.
scope_boundary: Plan-only import and selection recovery; no repository test executed and no canonical, replay, or independent-reproduction credit.
